file_set_id.description: Accession of the file set that contains this file: the unique identifier used to reference that file set on the source portal.

lab.description: Lab associated with the submission, as the portal's short lab name: lower-cased and hyphen-delimited from the PI's first and last name.

preferred_assay_titles.description: The lab's preferred label for the assay that produced the data. For an analysis set, the preferred assay titles of the assays whose data it analyzes. Null when the portal records none.

assay_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the assays used to produce the data.

method.description: The method the data is curated under in the catalog. Taken from the software title for prediction sets, from the preferred assay title for analysis and pseudobulk sets, and from the curated catalog method for externally sourced community data.

class.description: The class curated in the IGVF catalog that the data in this file belongs to: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship.

software.description: Software packages used to produce the file, under their preferred viewable names.

samples.description: Ontology terms identifying the biosamples the data was produced from, as handles into ontology_terms. Where a sample is an in vitro system with a differentiation endpoint, the targeted endpoint term is used in place of its starting term.

sample_ids.description: Accessions of the samples the data was produced from, as used to reference those samples on the source portal.

simple_sample_summaries.description: Short readable summary of each sample, assembled by the catalog from the sample's ontology term names, followed by 'induced to' and the targeted endpoint term for differentiated systems, 'from' and the donor accessions for organoid and specimen classifications, and 'treated with' and the treatment term names where treatments were applied.

donors.description: Donors the samples were derived from, as handles into the donors collection.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation.

publication.description: Publication identifier associated with the file set. Only one publication per file is supported.

collections.description: The collections in the IGVF catalog that contain the data in this file.

download_link.description: The download path to obtain the file from the source portal.

cell_annotation.description: The cell annotation of the file set, recorded for most scE2G file sets and all pseudobulk sets.
cell_annotation.example: pluripotent epiblast cell derived from mouse embryonic stem cell

cell_annotation_term.description: Ontology term describing the cell type of the cells in this pseudobulk or pseudobulk-derived prediction, as a handle into ontology_terms.

genome_browser_link.description: Link to a file that can be rendered in a genome browser: the file set's bigInteract, bigBed, bigWig, or bedpe file where one exists, or the file itself for a pseudobulk set.

browser_index_file.description: Download link for the genome browser index file (.tbi). Null for ENCODE files; for IGVF files, the tabix index file when present in the file set.

crispr_modality.description: The purpose or intended effect of the CRISPR modification applied to the samples. Null when no sample carries a CRISPR modification.

version.description: Version of the external data source, recorded only for community-curated files loaded into the catalog from outside IGVF and ENCODE.
